attributes.title: ENA Leadership Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Emergency Nurses Association holds its Leadership Conference 2027 on Thursday and Friday, January 28 and 29, 2027, at the Renaissance Schaumburg Convention Center Hotel in Schaumburg, Illinois, outside Chicago. It is a smaller, management-focused meeting, separate from ENA's large Emergency Nursing conference in the fall, and is aimed at charge nurses, managers, directors and educators in emergency departments.

The call for session proposals closed on October 5, 2026. Fees, the program and contact hours were not listed on the conference's official submission portal, which was the page we could check; ENA's own events page blocked automated access.
